spec.situation_desc: had a mortgage payment taken on the wrong date

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Zara speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Oskar Fitzgerald. My mortgage payment’s been taken on the wrong date, and I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry that’s happened, Oskar. I’ll look into it with you. Before we discuss the account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s all verified. I can see the payment was taken on the 18th rather than the 25th. I understand why that’s frustrating.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s happened without warning. I arranged for it to come out on the 25th.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry. I’ll take ownership of this and check what happened. I should also mention that mortgage fees can never be refunded, under our rules.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s not really reassuring. I want to know why it was taken early.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. I can’t promise what the outcome will be, but I am logging this as a complaint so the payment date can be investigated.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll send the details to our mortgage complaints team today, and I’ll call you by 30 October with an update. They’ll investigate and send you a full written response within 8 weeks of today.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay, so you’re passing it to the complaints team today, calling me by the 30th, and I’ll get a full response within eight weeks?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s right. I’ll make sure the referral and your preferred contact number are recorded. Does that make sense, and is there anything else you’d like me to note?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that makes sense. Please note that I expected the payment on the 25th.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I will. Thanks for explaining it, Oskar, and I’m sorry for the frustration this has caused.
